title: Fragments: October 28
author: Martin Fowler (martin@martinfowler.com)
description: Andrej Karpathy sees a widening gap in how people see LLM capabilities. The general public has mostly not interacted with these systems. When they have, it looks like a derpy chatbot. The majority of professionals still see only a modest uplift. And a small sliver of professionals are experiencing the vertigo of the…
summary: Andrej Karpathy sees a widening gap in how people see LLM capabilities. The general public has mostly not interacted with these systems.
takeaways: The idea is to get people out of their usual work environment, and spend one or two weeks with experienced coaches, learning how to use these tools well.
It’s short and it’s blunt: outside of 7 major tech companies, there is no data yet to support a productivity gain that justifies all the money pouring into tech.

Where might those good investments be this time? if you can build something that proves you got the answer, AI can get the answer much faster than you can, and there are real productivity gains to be had doing that generally.
